// IOrderable with a three-way comparison: negative when a < b, zero when equal,
// positive when a > b. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-way_comparison)
interface IComparable
    inherits IOrderable
{
    Compare(a: Self, b: Self): Integer;
}
